products.name: web-app
products.walk: Start the dev server on a reserved port, sign up with a test account, do the three main jobs, try bad input, check every link on the pages you touched.

products.name: desktop-app
products.walk: Run from a scratch HOME, first-run setup, import the sample data copy, export, reopen, check the export opens in the target tool.

products.name: cli
products.walk: Fresh virtualenv, install from the repo, run --help, follow the README quick start word for word, then the common error paths.
